BiblicalUsage: Kechash means deceitful, false, lying. Isaiah 30:9 says this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lying and rebellion walk together: a people that will not hear the law soon cannot tell the truth.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
